{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}")
print(qa_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status']])

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_orders = df[df['status'] == 'refunded']
print(f"Number of refunded orders: {len(refunded_orders)}")
print(refunded_orders[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue']])

# Check for -1 in customer_age
missing_age = df[df['customer_age'] == -1]
print(f"Number of customers with age = -1: {len(missing_age)}")
print(missing_age[['order_id', 'channel', 'customer_segment', 'customer_age', 'status', 'revenue']])

# Check for non-numeric revenue
print("Unique revenue values:")
print(df['revenue'].unique())"}
